description: Weighted pools of mission-task ids, used to choose the active task for a wave.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_MissionTaskLottery. Wave rows reference it as Id_MissionTaskLottery; the finder over MissionTaskLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x9F0) can skip None ids. No substantive consumer reads the member as data.

Id_MissionTask.simple: Candidate mission-task ids in the pool.
Id_MissionTask.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. BattleArcade_PickLotteryTask copies it with Weights, removes every None entry together with the same-index weight, then returns the task id at the weighted-picked index (NAME_None for an empty pool or no pick). The story demo task helper instead uses Id_MissionTask[0] directly when the array is non-empty. Exported rows pad unused slots with None.

Weights.simple: Relative weight for each candidate task.
Weights.technical: TArray<float>, default empty. After None candidates are removed, the weights are summed; BattleArcade_PickWeightIndex draws StoryFRand() * Sum and walks the array subtracting each weight until the roll is smaller, returning that index. If the walk exhausts the array it returns the last index; an empty pool returns NAME_None. Weights are therefore relative, not probabilities, and must stay index-aligned with Id_MissionTask.

notes: The exported asset contains 134 rows with FGameDataTableRow_MissionTaskLottery; the manager loads MissionTaskLotteryDataTable into MissionTaskLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x9F0).

The only full weighted consumer found is Arcade/PvE task selection via BattleArcade_PickLotteryTask (retail 0x1302490); PvE settings reuse the same helper. Story demo selection takes only the first id of the pool, so a row with several non-None tasks can behave differently by mode.
Lottery finder 0x12fb0a0 is labelled behavioural in status/functions.json; this is reconstructed behaviour. No localization variants or numbered shards were supplied for this table.
Only available C++ and the export were reviewed; Content is partial and Blueprint uses were not exhaustively inspectable.

usages.detail: BattleArcade_PickLotteryTask resolves a lottery row, filters None candidates and performs the weighted task pick.
Arcade battle setup converts each wave's Id_MissionTaskLottery into the task row used by the battle.
PvE settings call the same lottery picker for mission wave task ids.
Story demo objective lookup reads only the first candidate id from the lottery row.
